name: 烤鱼神话
description: 三十多年老灶火，盐城大丰源头活鱼现点现烤，全店无预制菜的川湘烤鱼品牌。

intro.zh: 三十多年老灶火，盐城大丰源头活鱼现点现烤，全店无预制菜。川湘家常味，街坊的老熟人。高兴了来，不高兴了更要来。
intro.en: Thirty-plus years of charcoal fire; live fish from Dafeng, Yancheng, grilled to order; no prefab dishes. Sichuan-Hunan home cooking — the neighborhood regular. Come when you're happy; come especially when you're not.

business.zh: 烤鱼、川湘菜、餐饮门店运营、品牌连锁与供应链协同。
business.en: Grilled fish, Sichuan-Hunan cuisine, restaurant operations, brand franchising, and supply-chain coordination.

notes.zh: 叙事与物料文案见 KaoyuShenhua/README.md。主口号：把实话坚持三十多年，就成了神话。已归档 Adobe Illustrator 原始标志，并提供网页预览与 PNG/JPG 导出。
notes.en: Narrative and store copy live in KaoyuShenhua/README.md. Primary slogan: thirty-plus years of plain truth becomes the myth. Original Illustrator logo archived with browser previews and PNG/JPG exports.
